title: Paul Gulacy
description: "l had a ball drawing the two mercenaries (from RETURN OF THE JEDI), but Id've much preferred Habba the Jut," proclaims Paul Gulacy, apparently a graduate of the Dan Quayle Institute for Misspelling. Gulacy first achieved fame with Marvel's MASTER OF KUNG FU ('74-'77), then continued to dazzle comics fans with SABRE, NIGHTMARES, SIX FROM SIRUS, BATMAN (in '86), CONAN, VALKYRIE! and JAMES BOND and THE TERMINATOR for Dark Horse.
